text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — need a short sync on the weekly performance deck + the post-launch signal stitching for yesterday's webinar. I spotted a leadflow mismatch between the dashboard and SFDC exports. Can we 10:30?

Omar Reyes: 10:30 works for me. any pointers on which query is conflicting?

Maya Chen: Dashboard shows ~420 leads in 'inbound > webinar' cohort, SFDC has 360. Curious if it's attribution window or duplicate filters.

Samir Patel: Likely the attribution window. The dashboard uses a 28-day rolling window, our SFDC report defaults to 30d and dedup on email. small difference but could explain ~10-12% gap.

Lena Novak: Also saw a router rule that tags some leads as "marketing:events" vs "inbound:webinar" depending on UTM. There's been a messy promo link we used in a handful of emails. I can pull the raw lead rows.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Samir can you paste the dashboard query you're using? I'll compare with the SFDC export.

Samir Patel: Sure — here's the simplified snippet we use in the cohort view:
```sql
SELECT count(distinct email) as leads
FROM lead_events
WHERE event_type = 'submission'
  AND campaign = 'spring-launch-webinar'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '28 days'
```
If SFDC export dedups by contact id and we have email variants, counts diverge.

Omar Reyes: Growth bot scheduled the nightly reconciliations but there's a delay on the export that might have missed late arrivals. growth-bot:report? @growth-bot

growth-bot: nightly-lead-reconcile finished @ 04:05 UTC — 174 missing rows from last 24h due to ingestion retry. See /data-pipeline/logs/ingest-2025-06-08.log :warning:

Lena Novak: That explains it. 174 missing + window differences covers the delta. We should mark the deck note as "inbound reconciliation in progress" and adjust the cohort delta column.

Maya Chen: Agreed. For the deck: propose we show both numbers (dashboard / SFDC) and a footnote: "SFDC export pending ingestion; discrepancy largely due to 28d vs 30d windows + late ingest (174 rows)." Draft slide I can update before the 11am leadership review.

Samir Patel: Also recommend adding a small AB test metric for webinar signups by promo link — the messy promo could bias channel attribution. quick SQL sample: 
```sql
SELECT promo_link, count(distinct email)
FROM lead_events
WHERE campaign = 'spring-launch-webinar'
GROUP BY promo_link
ORDER BY 2 desc
```
Will send numbers to this thread.

Omar Reyes: Thx. If we add both numbers + footnote it's defensible. Also let's add a remediation task: fix router rule + backfill the 174 rows. CC @data-ops.

Maya Chen: Assigning follow-ups: Lena will pull raw rows and send to data-ops; Samir will attach the exact queries for the deck; Omar will update the leadership slide with the dual-counts and footnote. I'll run the 11:00 review.

Lena Novak: sending the raw CSV now (S3 link) + a short sample of the messy UTMs.

Samir Patel: Uploaded cohort counts to thread; dashboard shows 420, post-backfill expected ~540 (including late ingest). I'll annotate the expected delta in the deck.

Maya Chen: Great work — resolved for now. We'll follow up after the backfill completes. :thumbsup:
